text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Dear Three Goddesses... I did my best to 
polish you up all nice and clean... How 
does it feel...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, they seem to be glowing. 
Fufu... I wonder if they took a liking to 
it?
